records.name: public registry and incremental IDNA
records.source:
text = input()
print(text)
import codecs
info = codecs.lookup('idna')
encoded = info.encode(text)[0]
print(encoded)
for split in range(len(encoded) + 1):
    decoder = info.incrementaldecoder()
    print(decoder.decode(encoded[:split], False) + decoder.decode(encoded[split:], True))
